statement: HSE describes effective shift handover as three linked elements: preparation by outgoing personnel, exchange of task-relevant information between outgoing and incoming personnel, and cross-checking by incoming personnel as responsibility is assumed.

review.rationale: Drafted from the reviewed UK Health and Safety Executive shift-handover guidance and cross-checked against the current HSE page on September 15, 2026. It is used as a transferable safety-critical communication model rather than as a claim that UK HSE requirements govern U.S. cannabis operations.
review.notes: Human operations/safety communication review is required before promotion; preserve the jurisdiction and transferability boundary.

sourceContext.contextTitle: Finish with a reconstructable shift state
